CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE `airline_agent_src_agent_flight_events` (
  `raw` STRING,
  `rec_ts` TIMESTAMP_LTZ(3) METADATA FROM 'timestamp',
  `event_ts` AS COALESCE(TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ(CAST(EVENT_FIELD(`raw`, 'ts', 'FlightEvent', '$.flightNumber') AS BIGINT), 3), `rec_ts`),
  WATERMARK FOR `event_ts` AS `event_ts` - INTERVAL '5.000' SECOND
) WITH (
  'connector' = 'kafka',
  'topic' = 'agent-flight-events',
  'properties.bootstrap.servers' = 'localhost:9092',
  'properties.group.id' = 'agent-airline-agent',
  'properties.auto.offset.reset' = 'latest',
  'scan.startup.mode' = 'group-offsets',
  'format' = 'raw'
)

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE `airline_agent_src_agent_catering_events` (
  `raw` STRING,
  `rec_ts` TIMESTAMP_LTZ(3) METADATA FROM 'timestamp',
  `event_ts` AS COALESCE(TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ(CAST(EVENT_FIELD(`raw`, 'ts', 'CateringEvent', '$.flightNumber') AS BIGINT), 3), `rec_ts`),
  WATERMARK FOR `event_ts` AS `event_ts` - INTERVAL '5.000' SECOND
) WITH (
  'connector' = 'kafka',
  'topic' = 'agent-catering-events',
  'properties.bootstrap.servers' = 'localhost:9092',
  'properties.group.id' = 'agent-airline-agent',
  'properties.auto.offset.reset' = 'latest',
  'scan.startup.mode' = 'group-offsets',
  'format' = 'raw'
)

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE `airline_agent_src_agent_passenger_events` (
  `raw` STRING,
  `rec_ts` TIMESTAMP_LTZ(3) METADATA FROM 'timestamp',
  `event_ts` AS COALESCE(TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ(CAST(EVENT_FIELD(`raw`, 'ts', 'PassengerEvent', '$.flightNumber') AS BIGINT), 3), `rec_ts`),
  WATERMARK FOR `event_ts` AS `event_ts` - INTERVAL '5.000' SECOND
) WITH (
  'connector' = 'kafka',
  'topic' = 'agent-passenger-events',
  'properties.bootstrap.servers' = 'localhost:9092',
  'properties.group.id' = 'agent-airline-agent',
  'properties.auto.offset.reset' = 'latest',
  'scan.startup.mode' = 'group-offsets',
  'format' = 'raw'
)

CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW `airline_agent_in` AS
SELECT
  `entity_id`, `event_type`, `source_topic`,
  EVENT_ENRICH(`payload`, '{"root":"","references":[{"name":"flights","type":"csv","file":"samples/airline-agent/enrichment/flights.csv","types":{}},{"name":"catering","type":"csv","file":"samples/airline-agent/enrichment/catering.csv","types":{}},{"name":"roster","type":"csv","file":"samples/airline-agent/enrichment/flight_passengers.csv","types":{}},{"name":"passengers","type":"csv","file":"samples/airline-agent/enrichment/passengers.csv","types":{}}],"steps":[{"reference":"flights","key":"flightNumber","on":"$.flightNumber","when":"$[?(@.type == ''FLIGHTOPEN'')]","into":"$.flight","fields":["flightNumber","aircraftId","aircraftType","date","origin","destination","duration"],"cardinality":null},{"reference":"catering","key":"flightNumber","on":"$.flightNumber","when":"$[?(@.type == ''FLIGHTOPEN'')]","into":"$.flight.cateringInformation","fields":["economyTotalMealCount","businessTotalMealCount","firstTotalMealCount"],"cardinality":null},{"reference":"roster","key":"flightNumber","on":"$.flightNumber","when":"$[?(@.type == ''FLIGHTOPEN'')]","into":"$.flight.passengers","fields":["passengerId",{"checkInStatus":"check-inStatus"},"travelClass"],"cardinality":"many"},{"reference":"passengers","key":"passengerId","on":"$.passengerId","when":null,"into":"$.flight.passengers[*]","fields":["name","birthdate","citizenship","residenceCountry","loyaltyStatus"],"cardinality":null}]}') AS `payload`,
  `event_ts`
FROM (
SELECT
  EVENT_FIELD(`raw`, 'entity_id', 'FlightEvent', '$.flightNumber') AS `entity_id`,
  EVENT_FIELD(`raw`, 'event_type', 'FlightEvent', '$.flightNumber') AS `event_type`,
  CAST('agent-flight-events' AS STRING) AS `source_topic`,
  EVENT_FIELD(`raw`, 'payload', 'FlightEvent', '$.flightNumber') AS `payload`,
  `event_ts`
FROM `airline_agent_src_agent_flight_events`
)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  EVENT_FIELD(`raw`, 'entity_id', 'CateringEvent', '$.flightNumber') AS `entity_id`,
  EVENT_FIELD(`raw`, 'event_type', 'CateringEvent', '$.flightNumber') AS `event_type`,
  CAST('agent-catering-events' AS STRING) AS `source_topic`,
  EVENT_FIELD(`raw`, 'payload', 'CateringEvent', '$.flightNumber') AS `payload`,
  `event_ts`
FROM `airline_agent_src_agent_catering_events`
UNION ALL
SELECT
  EVENT_FIELD(`raw`, 'entity_id', 'PassengerEvent', '$.flightNumber') AS `entity_id`,
  EVENT_FIELD(`raw`, 'event_type', 'PassengerEvent', '$.flightNumber') AS `event_type`,
  CAST('agent-passenger-events' AS STRING) AS `source_topic`,
  EVENT_FIELD(`raw`, 'payload', 'PassengerEvent', '$.flightNumber') AS `payload`,
  `event_ts`
FROM `airline_agent_src_agent_passenger_events`

CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW `airline_agent_out` AS
SELECT * FROM `event_rule_airline_agent`(
    events => TABLE `airline_agent_in` PARTITION BY `entity_id`,
    on_time => DESCRIPTOR(`event_ts`),
    uid => 'agent-processor-airline-agent')

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE `airline_agent_sink_agent_flight_notifications` (
  `k` STRING,
  `v` STRING
) WITH (
  'connector' = 'kafka',
  'topic' = 'agent-flight-notifications',
  'properties.bootstrap.servers' = 'localhost:9092',
  'key.format' = 'raw',
  'key.fields' = 'k',
  'value.format' = 'raw',
  'value.fields-include' = 'EXCEPT_KEY',
  'sink.delivery-guarantee' = 'at-least-once',
  'sink.transactional-id-prefix' = 'airline_agent_sink_agent_flight_notifications'
)

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE `airline_agent_sink_agent_passenger_notifications` (
  `k` STRING,
  `v` STRING
) WITH (
  'connector' = 'kafka',
  'topic' = 'agent-passenger-notifications',
  'properties.bootstrap.servers' = 'localhost:9092',
  'key.format' = 'raw',
  'key.fields' = 'k',
  'value.format' = 'raw',
  'value.fields-include' = 'EXCEPT_KEY',
  'sink.delivery-guarantee' = 'at-least-once',
  'sink.transactional-id-prefix' = 'airline_agent_sink_agent_passenger_notifications'
)

INSERT INTO `airline_agent_sink_agent_passenger_notifications`
SELECT `entity_id`, EVENT_ENRICH(`envelope`, '{"root":"payload","references":[{"name":"passengers","type":"csv","file":"samples/airline-agent/enrichment/passengers.csv","types":{}}],"steps":[{"reference":"passengers","key":"passengerId","on":"$.passengerNumber","when":null,"into":"$","fields":["name","loyaltyStatus","email","phone","contactPreference"],"cardinality":null}]}')
FROM `airline_agent_out`
WHERE `out_type` = 'PassengerNotification'

  'sink.delivery-guarantee' = 'at-least-once',

) WITH (
